 ANO: H1 FY27 sales outlook weakens as sunscreen sales recover and 2027 product plans advance
 Less than 1 min read ANO H1 FY27 sales revenue is forecast to decline 11%–18% as Australian sales weakness weighs on profit, while Q1 sunscreen sales had recovered from a 71% decline to 20% by end-October. Priorities include expanding distribution, launching High Purity White Sapphire and developing a solid-state battery prototype in 2027. 
 Original document: Advance ZincTek Limited [ANO] Slides Release — Nov. 19 2026
